limits: Real SerialTransport is tested with a stand-in factory only. CLI exposes no COM/serial-port parameter.
No device/firmware identity verified by UART protocol; manifest binds historical fixture only.
No process restart execution resume; progress viewing only.
Drain stops after nominal 10ms quiet or 100ms budget, plus at most one 50ms blocking read; unread/future bytes are not claimed.
No physical RAM retention, DTR/RTS waveform, PM restore, ADC, touch, BLE, current or battery-life verification.
Historical/simulated data never marks a new hardware experiment complete; a protocol pass and short BAT window remain distinct.
